label: operations_only_development
selection_disclosure: All periods were previously viewed before v2 design; neither variant is fresh out-of-sample evidence. Both variants and every result are retained.

fair_coin_policy.interpretation: Conditional random-policy benchmark rank; not a formal exchangeable permutation p-value.

long_bias_control_policy.interpretation: Conditional random-policy benchmark rank; not a formal exchangeable permutation p-value.

weekly_block_bootstrap.unit: calendar week, grouped by trade exit, including zero-trade weeks
weekly_block_bootstrap.limitation: Few calendar blocks give imprecise intervals; days and trades are not assumed independent.

funding.calculation: Native-verified CURRENCY_PROFIT mode 9; profit currency USD; static exported rates per lot.
funding.limitation: Static exported rates and midnight broker-server rollover are used; historical rate changes are unavailable.

execution_dataset.type: native real-tick bid/ask quotes aggregated to M1
execution_dataset.period_end: Forced native-tester settlement at actual last quote, including closed sessions.

limitations: All policies share strategy-conditioned opportunity times. This evaluates directional choices conditional on that timing, not arbitrary timing skill.
Random trade directions change holding periods and therefore trade counts; every path enforces one position.
The long-bias control uses the observed executed-trade long proportion as a Bernoulli probability; exact counts are not fixed.
Separately aggregated bid/ask quote OHLC is used when available; legacy fallback approximates asks from bid bars and spread snapshots.
Trades cannot enter or touch SL/TP outside broker trade sessions. Partial session-boundary minute OHLC can contain closed-session quotes and remains approximate.

Daily flat exits wait for the first quoted tradable minute at/after 20:00 broker-server time, or Friday 17:00; the unchanged 72-H1-bar limit also applies. Within-minute ordering and seconds remain approximate, with adverse same-minute SL/TP priority.
Drawdown is based on closed balances and excludes open-position mark-to-market excursions.
Native MT5 and same-engine actual-policy results must be compared before interpreting benchmark ranks.
These results are a historical conditional benchmark, not proof of future profitability or a formal randomized experiment.

native_entry_comparison.interpretation: MT5 is primary. Minute aggregation and additional-cost sizing can cause differences; discrepancies have not been forced to match.
